section: Opus code-reviewer on the register, parser, CLI, tests and data (all findings fixed or answered in this diff)

review.finding: The ask-destructive-db note said TRUNCATE and DELETE without WHERE are not matched; the hook matches them, and the note left out that it is a post-write reminder on migration .sql only and fails open without Python.
review.suggestion: Rewritten for ask-destructive-db and esc-destructive-sql. Fixed.

review.finding: compliance-after-phase claimed a hook; the Stop audit hook is diagnostic and never blocks.
review.suggestion: Reclassified prompt-only (mechanisable) with a note. Fixed.

review.finding: self-review-before-commit named the recorder, not the check; review-in-stages was classed inconsistently with the same F11 gate.
review.suggestion: Both now validator via verifiers/review_record_check.py with an iterate-only, post-commit note. Fixed.

review.finding: ask-override-gates was under-claimed; the code enforces a force reason and the autonomy allowlist.
review.suggestion: Now validator with the three orchestrator files. Fixed.

review.finding: ask-prod-deploy and esc-prod-deploy were judgement-only though release.py refuses prod without confirm_prod.
review.suggestion: Now validator via release.py with a scope note. Fixed.

review.finding: The parser silently dropped unplaced lines and unknown sections, so a new rule in an unrecognised shape needed no entry.
review.suggestion: parse() now returns strays (unplaced lines, unknown headings); check() fails on them; tests added. Fixed.

review.finding: A hook entry only had to exist on disk, not be registered; absolute paths bypassed the repo root.
review.suggestion: A hook entry must name a script registered in a plugin hooks.json; absolute and .. paths are rejected. Fixed.

review.finding: never-recursive-delete-root overstated the hook and cited an unregistered copy.
Test-layer and skip rows were broader than the validator and had empty notes.
review.suggestion: Notes added: final outcome only, retries are prose, pgTAP skip unchecked, run pipeline only. Fixed.

review.finding: Regenerating the doc by shell redirection writes UTF-16 in Windows PowerShell.
review.suggestion: Added --write (UTF-8, LF) and documented it instead of redirection. Fixed.

review.finding: An entry without text_hash raised KeyError; two identical rule texts collapsed to one hash.
review.suggestion: Missing keys and identical rule texts are reported as problems. Fixed.
Added scripts/hooks/pre-commit and anti_ratchet.py with a note. Fixed.

review.finding: The FR-01.11 tag is a doubtful binding.
review.suggestion: Kept deliberately: the tag gate needs one tag; the test states that no AC is claimed. Not changed.

review.finding: Triage sweep lines in the diff are scope noise.
